guidanceMessages.html: When exporting this quote from CRM, use the Standard report type.
When exporting this quote from CRM, use the Start End Date report type.

When exporting this quote from CRM,

  • To NOT show SOH or Disc% use the Standard report type.
  • To show Stock SOH use the Hardware SOH report type.
  • To show Stock SOH and Disc% use the Hardware SOH Disc % report type.

When exporting this quote from CRM,

  • To show Stock SOH use the Hardware SOH report type.
  • To show Stock SOH and Disc% use the Hardware SOH Disc % report type.

When exporting this quote from CRM, use the Start End Date report type.

Select Split output by SAID if you want a separate xlsx file for each Service Agreement ID
